instruction: How to install swanctl on Debian
How to install pki tool for certificates
How to generate CA key and cert with strongSwan pki
output: pki --gen --type rsa --size 2048 --outform pem > /etc/swanctl/private/ca.key && pki --self --ca --in /etc/swanctl/private/ca.key --dn 'CN=Example CA, O=Example' --outform pem > /etc/swanctl/x509ca/ca.crt

instruction: How to generate server certificate with strongSwan pki
output: pki --gen --type rsa --size 2048 --outform pem > /etc/swanctl/private/server.key && pki --pub --in /etc/swanctl/private/server.key | pki --issue --cacert /etc/swanctl/x509ca/ca.crt --cakey /etc/swanctl/private/ca.key --dn 'CN=server.example.com, O=Example' --san server.example.com --flag serverAuth --flag ikeIntermediate --outform pem > /etc/swanctl/x509/server.crt

instruction: How to generate client certificate with strongSwan pki
output: pki --gen --type rsa --size 2048 --outform pem > /etc/swanctl/private/client.key && pki --pub --in /etc/swanctl/private/client.key | pki --issue --cacert /etc/swanctl/x509ca/ca.crt --cakey /etc/swanctl/private/ca.key --dn 'CN=client.example.com, O=Example' --san client.example.com --outform pem > /etc/swanctl/x509/client.crt
